name.en: Open model and data provenance reproduction

question.zh: 同一公共任务如何先由普通服务可靠完成，再判断 AI 是否带来可证明的增益？——开放模型与数据来源复现
question.en: How can the same civic task work reliably without AI before any AI benefit is considered? — Open model and data provenance reproduction

space.zh: 众智园能力验证庭·复现室

ordinary_answer.zh: 人工登记模型版本、数据许可和复现步骤，提供离线检查清单。
ordinary_answer.en: A staffed registry, paper/offline checklist and manual licence review reproduce versions and provenance.

ai_answer.zh: 在隔离环境运行可选复现助手，生成差异报告但不替代专业签字。
ai_answer.en: An optional assistant runs in isolation and produces a difference report without replacing professional sign-off.

minimum_data.zh: 公开模型卡、数据许可、版本哈希、运行日志。
minimum_data.en: Published model card, data licence, version hash and run log.

human_responsibility.zh: 可信评测负责人核对来源、许可和差异；批准公开等级。
human_responsibility.en: The trust-evaluation lead verifies licence and differences and approves disclosure.

admission_conditions.zh: 来源、许可、隔离环境和人工审核人齐备。
admission_conditions.en: The ordinary answer for T1 is independently operational; accountable staff, minimum data and restoration route are verified.

stop_conditions.zh: 发现无权数据、无法解释的外联或复现环境越界时立即停止。
stop_conditions.en: Stop T1 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

exit_and_restore.zh: 删除临时副本，保留经人工确认的清单、日志哈希和普通登记台。
exit_and_restore.en: Remove and isolate the optional T1 equipment; retain the complete staffed, static and accessible baseline.

name.zh: 机器人—行人—无障碍受控测试

question.zh: 同一公共任务如何先由普通服务可靠完成，再判断 AI 是否带来可证明的增益？——机器人—行人—无障碍受控测试
question.en: How can the same civic task work reliably without AI before any AI benefit is considered? — Controlled robot–pedestrian–accessibility test

space.zh: 众智园能力验证庭·围合测试环

ordinary_answer.zh: 以人工安全员、实体隔离、步行优先路线和手动急停完成小规模测试。
ordinary_answer.en: A safety steward, physical separation, pedestrian-priority route and manual emergency stop support the test.

ai_answer.zh: 可选低速机器人在限定时窗和限定速度内运行，实时记录近失误与人工接管。
ai_answer.en: An optional low-speed robot runs only inside a controlled window and records near misses and takeovers.

minimum_data.zh: 匿名事件计数、速度、制动距离、接管时间、测试时窗。
minimum_data.en: Anonymous incident counts, speed, braking distance, takeover time and test window.

human_responsibility.zh: 现场安全主管拥有独立断电权；无障碍观察员共同复核。
human_responsibility.en: The site safety lead holds independent power-off authority with an accessibility observer.

admission_conditions.zh: 普通通路持续开放，隔离、急停、保险和人员培训完成。
admission_conditions.en: The ordinary answer for T2 is independently operational; accountable staff, minimum data and restoration route are verified.

stop_conditions.zh: 任何人进入安全缓冲区、连续两次近失误或急停失效即停止。
stop_conditions.en: Stop T2 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

exit_and_restore.zh: 机器人撤库、临时围栏拆除；保留步行路径、座椅与事件公告位。
exit_and_restore.en: Remove and isolate the optional T2 equipment; retain the complete staffed, static and accessible baseline.

operation_window.zh: 公众旁路 24 小时；机器人测试建议仅 10:00–12:00 / 14:00–16:00，并由现场许可复核
operation_window.en: Public bypass 24/7; robot trial proposed only 10:00–12:00 / 14:00–16:00, subject to site approval

question.en: How can the same civic task work reliably without AI before any AI benefit is considered? — Edge compute energy, noise and offline degradation test

space.zh: 众智园能力验证庭·可拆机柜带
space.en: Capability Validation Court · removable cabinet bay

ordinary_answer.zh: 普通服务以纸质流程、人工台账和独立照明运行。
ordinary_answer.en: Paper procedures, a staffed log and independent lighting keep the ordinary service operational.

ai_answer.zh: 可拆端侧机柜仅处理必要任务，并在断网时自动降级到人工流程。
ai_answer.en: A removable edge cabinet handles only necessary tasks and degrades to the staffed process when offline.

minimum_data.zh: 设备功率、任务量、噪声、温度、断网与恢复日志。
minimum_data.en: Power, task count, noise, temperature, outage and recovery logs.

human_responsibility.zh: 设施运维负责人每日核验能耗、热环境和降级结果。
human_responsibility.en: The facilities lead verifies energy, thermal conditions and degradation daily.

admission_conditions.zh: 独立回路、断网演练、消防和热管理审查完成。
admission_conditions.en: The ordinary answer for T3 is independently operational; accountable staff, minimum data and restoration route are verified.

stop_conditions.zh: 超过许可噪声/热环境、异常外传或降级失败时停止。
stop_conditions.en: Stop T3 when safety, rights, data minimisation, human takeover or reliable degradation fails; the human lead has final authority.

question.en: How can the same civic task work reliably without AI before any AI benefit is considered? — Staffed enterprise service with optional AI triage

space.zh: AI 原点公共转译厅·企业窗口
space.en: AI Origin Public Translation Hall · enterprise desk

ordinary_answer.zh: 人工窗口用纸质清单说明法务、知识产权、评测和融资路径。
ordinary_answer.en: A staffed desk and printed directory explain legal, IP, evaluation and finance routes.

ai_answer.zh: 可选分诊助手按公开目录建议下一站，不生成正式法律或投资意见。
ai_answer.en: Optional triage suggests the next desk from a public directory and never issues formal legal or investment advice.

minimum_data.zh: 问题类别、转介去向、等待时间、人工改判原因。
minimum_data.en: Question class, referral, waiting time and reason for human override.

human_responsibility.zh: 窗口主管确认所有转介；专业事项由持证人员处理。
human_responsibility.en: The desk lead confirms every referral; licensed professionals handle specialist matters.

admission_conditions.zh: 服务目录、人工窗口和责任边界先独立运行。
admission_conditions.en: The ordinary answer for S1 is independently operational; accountable staff, minimum data and restoration route are verified.

stop_conditions.zh: 高风险事项被自动决定、连续误分诊或人工窗口不可用时停止 AI。
